# Plumbing Paramedic 911 — Abbeville, SC

> Plumbing Paramedic 911 is a licensed, insured, family-owned 24/7 emergency plumbing company based in Abbeville, South Carolina and serving Abbeville, Greenwood, Anderson, Laurens, McCormick and surrounding Upstate communities. Owner Eric Callaway is a South Carolina Master Plumber; he has worked in the plumbing trade since 1996 and founded Plumbing Paramedic 911 in 2015. Call (864) 446-8911 — available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Address: 13 Callaway Dr, Abbeville, SC 29620.

## Pricing Facts
- Plumbing repairs and installations use upfront flat-rate pricing approved before work begins.
- Service / diagnostic call: **$79** Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM.
- After-hours and weekend service / diagnostic call: **$99**.
- After-midnight and holiday service / diagnostic call: **$158**.
- Military, veteran, senior and first-responder discount: **10%** where applicable; discounts do not stack.
- Final repair or installation price can change when code-required upgrades, concealed conditions or special materials are discovered; changes are quoted before authorization.
